description: Hand-verified ground truth from the 2026-10-10 agent-instruction rot research. 'stale' = verified against the code at the pinned commit. 'not_stale' = a plausible-looking finding that was rejected on verification (false-positive traps). 'clean_files' = files audited with no stale claims found. Severity: high = silently produces wrong work; medium = fails loudly; low = harmless/cosmetic. Verified by: claude (direct code check) or agent (sub-agent audit, not independently re-checked).
